name: io.github.cyanheads/onebusaway-mcp-server
description: Real-time transit stops, routes, arrivals, vehicle positions, and schedules via OneBusAway APIs.

environmentVariables.name: ONEBUSAWAY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OneBusAway API key. TEST works on the Puget Sound instance for development.

environmentVariables.name: ONEBUSAWAY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the OneBusAway instance. Defaults to Puget Sound.

environmentVariables.name: ONEBUSAWAY_RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS
environmentVariables.description: Upstream requests the pacer allows per window.

environmentVariables.name: ONEBUSAWAY_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS
environmentVariables.description: Width of the pacer's sliding rate window, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: ONEBUSAWAY_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Longest a call may wait in the pacer queue, in milliseconds. Keep it under the SDK client's 60 s request timeout.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warning').
